title: Proof-grade contract and protocol vulnerability analysis

requirements.text: Build closed CFGs with real branch, join, loop-exit, abrupt-exit, reachability, and dominator facts.
Use function-scoped, dominance-aware mitigation analysis for severity, confidence, and suppression decisions.
Report every finding cap and dropped count; never silently truncate rules or engine results.
Grant EXECUTED only for a parsed counterexample and REPRODUCED only after deterministic replay.
Preserve replayable seeds, ordered calls, invariant identifiers, block numbers, and artifact references.
Build a protocol-level graph linking contracts, calls, storage roles, assets, and economic components.
Consume scenario packs against protocol-derived model state and emit scoped model counterexamples.
Support optional Anvil fork replay at a pinned block without requiring a signing key.
Allow verified-source targets to use source-only external engines while explicitly explaining project-only engine limits.
Expose evidence labels, reachability, mitigations, truncations, protocol graph, and replay metadata in CLI, reports, and desktop.
Fail closed on evidence overstatement, bound all execution and inputs, preserve cancellation, and distinguish model proof from deployed-code proof.
